title: Analytics tasks
responsibility: Displays response and clean-code assessment history by task.

inputs.name: AnalyticsTasks.jev
inputs.description: Required Jev summary containing response and clean-code task arrays. Each row supplies task, loop/step, author model, assessed attempts, first-pass flag, attempts-to-pass and optional report identifier.

outputs.name: AnalyticsTasks
outputs.description: Two task tables with missing text as a dash and links for supplied report IDs. First pass shows Yes when flagged, otherwise No for assessed attempts or Not assessed for none. Null attempts-to-pass is Not yet passed. Describes excluded cached/dry/incomplete runs; relies on supplied assessed counts.
